Coordinator called weather -> risk -> planner -> safety -> finalize itself (5 coordinator calls). Risk explanation and plan intro from the model were kept (passed claim checks). Weather summary said 'no precipitation expected' (not flagged by claims; tool precipitation was 0.0). DEVIATIONS: (1) Coordinator tools are effectively no-arg: weather_intelligence(location='', forecast_days=3) and action_planner(revision_notes='') accept but ignore args; the run's request and the latest verification issues are always used (D1). (2) When weather is no_data/error, risk is not run (risk=None, risk_category 'unknown') and the fallback does nothing further; report incomplete, verification not_run. (3) Coordinator guardrail blocks go to consistency_issues ('Coordinator guardrail blocked ...'), steering blocks to steering_blocks. (4) needs_human_review adds a notice asking a person to review. (5) Extra test test_fallback_runs_revision_once and test_steering_rules_unit beyond (a)-(h). (6) Steering held order, so GraphBuilder not used; design.md §7.4 updated and §8 added.
